video_title: Shams on Jaylen Brown’s future if the Celtics acquire Giannis in a trade | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks are weighing trade offers from Celtics and Heat for Giannis
quotes.excerpt: Bucks are literally right now in their offices figuring out which direction they're going to go.
quotes.quote: Bucks executives are literally right now in their offices figuring out which direction they're going to go because there are two offers right now that it's come down to at a serious and significant level. That's the Celtics offer led by Jaylen Brown, who is a superstar, there's other additional pieces of that deal, or an offer from the Miami Heat that consists of several players, players that you have control over on rookie scale contracts, guys that you can extend at a reasonable number, and a surplus of draft capital. They're two totally different offers the Bucks are trying to navigate internally.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis trade resolution expected before the NBA Draft
quotes.excerpt: My reporting is that there will be a decision before the NBA Draft.
quotes.quote: Everything that I hear, all of my sense and my reporting is that there will be a decision before the NBA Draft. There's going to be a resolution before the draft, so I think over the next 24 hours, there's going to be a resolution. This has been something that's been going on for 13 months, but at a serious level since February when the Bucks took a bunch of calls, got a bunch of offers that really laid the groundwork for what we're seeing right now.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics and Heat are the only teams with Giannis's commitment
quotes.excerpt: The Heat and the Celtics are the only two teams involved that have gotten the commitment from Giannis.
quotes.quote: The Heat and the Celtics are the only two teams involved that have gotten the commitment from Giannis that he is willing to sign long-term. That's allowed Milwaukee to really leverage both of these teams against each other. Now they have a decision to make and both deals are totally different, but we'll know here in the next 24 hours is my sense on where this is going.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics not shopping Jaylen Brown despite trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: To my knowledge, they're not shopping Jaylen Brown. This is a very specific situation.

text_blocks.speaker: Connor Campbell
text_blocks.text: Now that Jaylen Brown is on the table officially, is it safe to say whether he goes and gets traded in this deal or if the Bucks end up going with the Heat deal, that the Celtics are probably going to move Jaylen Brown now just because his name's out there, he might not like the fact that he's being shopped? What is the situation there if the Celtics don't get the Giannis trade?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: Everyone around the league is going to be talking about this. If this deal does not get done for the Celtics, what is the future of Jaylen Brown? The thing the Celtics do have though, and Jaylen Brown knows this, is he's got multiple years left on his deal. To my knowledge, they're not shopping Jaylen Brown. This is a very specific situation. This is now twice in four years where the Celtics have offered Jaylen Brown in a major trade for a future Hall of Famer. In 2022, they offered him as well as other pieces for Kevin Durant. They missed on that. Now they're going after Giannis and they've put Jaylen Brown on the table.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Dusty May hired as new Dallas Mavericks head coach
quotes.excerpt: University of Michigan coach Dusty May has agreed to become the new head coach of the Dallas Mavericks.
quotes.quote: University of Michigan coach Dusty May has agreed to become the new head coach of the Dallas Mavericks. The Mavericks, when Masai Ujiri came in, they fired Jason Kidd pretty immediately and their focus has been trying to get a splash. They could have hired a first-time assistant, a rising assistant coach in the NBA, but there were two people that Masai Ujiri and the Mavericks pursued the last few weeks very aggressively. One was John Scheyer at Duke, they went after him, and Dusty May. The Mavericks had to figure out which direction they want to go, which coach they want to lead Cooper Flagg and potentially Kyrie Irving being on this team next season and beyond.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy and Herb Jones are drawing significant trade interest
quotes.excerpt: You definitely have to look at a couple players in New Orleans, Trey Murphy, Herb Jones.
quotes.quote: You definitely have to look at a couple players in New Orleans, Trey Murphy, Herb Jones. Those are two players that have gotten a ton of interest in the marketplace. A lot of people are keeping an eye and monitoring the Kawhi Leonard situation with the Clippers. He's got one year left on his deal. We don't know how that's going to play out with the Clippers. There's no urgency there, they've been through this with Kawhi before where they're entering the last year of his deal.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves looking to upgrade roster around Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota has been involved in the Giannis thing at different points. They know they need an upgrade.
quotes.quote: Minnesota has been involved in the Giannis thing at different points. They're not involved right now. What happens there? They know they need to make an upgrade, they know they need to add something to this team with Anthony Edwards on it. They've made a pitch on a bunch of different guys around the league. We'll see who they can come up with, but there's going to be a lot of tentacles that come out.
